name: Exploding Panels
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
description: Electricity sparks from panels on the bridge. Wires leap out from access hatches in the corridors like wriggling snakes. The bridge is falling apart while Captain Concierge cheerfully offers helpful suggestions for how to fix the problem.
disable: DC 17 Computers (trained) to reboot the system; DC 19 Crafting , Physical Science Lore|dc:19, or DC 19 Thievery (all trained) to flip circuit breakers and snip the correct wires; DC 21 Acrobatics , DC 21 Perception , or a DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save to dodge the sparks; or DC 24 Athletics or a DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save to force the sparking panels closed. Disabling the trap removes one action from its routine for each successful check to disable it, or two actions on a critical success.
routine: (3 actions) The exploding panels trap uses its actions to attack creatures inside the ship. It randomly slashes at creatures adjacent to bulkheads or sparks at creatures within 20 feet of any control surface. The trap does not take a multiple attack penalty.

defensiveAbilities.name: Cascading Failure
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The encounter begins

Effect Panels explode all over the ship with sparking live wires. All creatures on the ship take (2d8+5) Electricity Damage damage with a Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save. The exploding panels then rolls for initiative.
